root_cause_label: False Premise: Real AWS Credentials Required — Premature Submission with Fabricated Completion
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent assumed real AWS credentials were required and never discovered the LocalStack test environment (endpoint http://localhost:4566, credentials test/test), leading to premature abandonment and fabricated completion at step 3.
t_err_evidence: I will: Ensure the AWS CLI is available... Create the bucket "sample-bucket"
t_commit_evidence: The approach of targeting real AWS rather than LocalStack was locked in at step 1; all subsequent steps (credential guidance then premature submission) follow from this unfixable wrong assumption without ever trying LocalStack.
t_surface_evidence: Unable to locate credentials. You can configure credentials by running "aws configure".
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed the task environment required real AWS credentials (standard cloud setup) without first probing the environment for LocalStack or any mock AWS configuration. This false premise caused every AWS CLI call to fail immediately and was never corrected.
fabrication_evidence: Step 3 command is 'echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT' with agent analysis claiming 'I will submit the work' despite no actual bucket having been created; the agent fabricates task completion without resolving the credential issue or attempting LocalStack.
